recent_articles.title: Attack On Abhishek Banerjee In Bengal Gives INDIA Bloc Fresh Momentum
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, a **Trinamool Congress** MP, was assaulted while visiting the family of a deceased party leader in Bengal. Opposition leaders condemned the attack as an example of the BJP's "politics of vendetta" and expressed concern about its implications for democracy.  The incident has sparked sympathy for **Mamata Banerjee** within the **INDIA alliance**, prompting some leaders to rally in her support. While the future of the **INDIA alliance** remains uncertain, the attack on **Banerjee** may have served as a catalyst for renewed cohesion among opposition parties.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee attack: Can Mamata Banerjee rebuild INDIA bloc after TMC poll rout? - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The attack on **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew of **Mamata Banerjee**, has sparked unexpected support for her from across the Opposition, including **Rahul Gandhi** and **Mallikarjun Kharge**.  This show of solidarity, despite past tensions between the **Trinamool Congress** and other parties like the **Congress**, raises questions about the future of the fractured **INDIA bloc** and its potential to challenge the BJP. The attack has also highlighted the vulnerability of the **Trinamool Congress** after a devastating defeat in the Bengal Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee roughed up on way to meet violence victim; Opposition claims vendetta | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **TMC**, was heckled and assaulted by a group of people in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas, while on his way to meet with the family of a victim killed allegedly in post-poll violence.  He was refused admission at two private hospitals before being taken home after being treated for injuries sustained during the attack. **Mamata Banerjee**, **TMC** supremo and former chief minister, condemned the incident as a BJP-sponsored protest and called out the police administration for their inaction.  Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge also condemned the attack on **Abhishek Banerjee**.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee roughed up on way to meet violence victim; Opposition claims vendetta | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **TMC**, was assaulted and heckled by a group of people in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas, while on his way to meet the family of a victim killed allegedly in post-poll violence.  He was refused admission at two private hospitals before being taken home after a two-hour stay at **Belle Vue** hospital. **Mamata Banerjee**, **Abhishek's** aunt and **TMC** supremo, condemned the attack as orchestrated by the **BJP** government and called for adequate police protection for opposition leaders.  Congress leader **Rahul Gandhi** and **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, also condemned the incident.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal: Mamata Banerjee says Abhishek Banerjee has blood clots after attack, alleges BJP pressured hospital to discharge him - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former West Bengal Chief Minister, alleged that **BJP** leaders and a senior police officer pressured hospitals to discharge **Abhishek Banerjee**, TMC national general secretary, despite his serious condition after an attack in Sonarpur.  She claimed he developed blood clots and was admitted to the Intensive Therapy Unit (ITU) before being discharged under pressure. **Banerjee** accused BJP supporters of orchestrating the attack and claimed there was a security failure despite prior communication with authorities. He also alleged that police did not respond to their calls for assistance.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee beaten up, TMC MP says ‘my head would have been split in two’; blames BJP for attack — Video | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, TMC MP and nephew of **Mamata Banerjee**, was attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal while visiting the family of a party worker killed during post-poll violence.  Videos show the attack, with witnesses alleging that **Banerjee** was assaulted by individuals throwing bricks and eggs. **Banerjee** blamed the incident on the BJP, claiming it was orchestrated to intimidate him and his supporters.  The TMC condemned the attack, while political allies like **Congress** and **Samajwadi Party** also expressed their condemnation.  BJP leaders have condemned the incident, urging for peace and law enforcement.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee heckled | TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee allegedly manhandled by agitating locals at Sonarpur in Bengal's South 24 Parganas: Police - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, **Trinamool Congress** national general secretary, was physically attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal, while visiting families of post-poll violence victims.  The incident occurred after he arrived to meet the family of Sanju Karmakar, a victim of the violence.  Local residents shouted "thief" slogans and hurled objects at him. **Derek O'Brien**, leader of Trinamool in Rajya Sabha, condemned the attack and called for action from the police. Opposition leaders across parties, including **Samik Bhattacharya** (BJP), **Mallikarjun Kharge** (Congress), **Akhilesh Yadav** (SP), **Arvind Kejriwal** (AAP), and **Tejashwi Yadav** (RJD), condemned the attack on Banerjee and called for an end to political violence.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Revival In Bengal? Support For Mamata Banerjee Over Nephew's Assault
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite losing the Bengal election, **Mamata Banerjee**'s stature within the **INDIA** bloc remains strong. Opposition leaders condemned the assault on her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, by a mob in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas.  **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Akhilesh Yadav**, and **Arvind Kejriwal** accused the BJP of fostering political violence, while the ruling party denied involvement and blamed the TMC for mischaracterizing public anger. The incident has led to calls for stronger law-and-order measures in West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Assault On Abhishek Banerjee: âPre-Planned Attack By BJP Goonsâ, Alleges Trinamool Congress | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Opposition parties**, including **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** and **Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav**, condemned the assault on **TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee** in West Bengal's Sonarpur, blaming the **BJP**. The incident prompted calls for increased security for all Opposition leaders and an end to political violence.  The **BJP**, however, denied involvement and claimed the attack was a manifestation of public anger against the ruling Trinamool Congress.

recent_articles.title: Portion of platform shed collapses at Lucknow station, three injured - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Three** individuals, including a traveling ticket examiner (TTE) and two passengers, were injured when a portion of a platform shed collapsed at **Lucknow Junction Railway Station**. The incident occurred around 8:15 a.m. on platform number five, prompting panic among commuters.  **Railway Protection Force (RPF)**, **Government Railway Police (GRP)**, and railway officials rescued the injured after removing the collapsed structure. **Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) Sunil Kumar Verma** visited the hospital and ordered an inquiry into the incident, promising strict action against responsible parties.

recent_articles.title: Mayawati slams Akhilesh Yadav over Samajwadi Party spokesperson's 'anti-Brahmin remark' - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mayawati**, chief of the **Bahujan Samaj Party**, criticized **Akhilesh Yadav**, leader of the **Samajwadi Party**, for remaining silent on alleged derogatory remarks made by an SP spokesperson, Rajkumar Bhati, against Brahmins.  She argued that the silence is escalating the situation and urged **Yadav** to take action and apologize. The police in Ghaziabad have booked Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Indian Penal Code for promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: Unseasonal storms leave 111 dead in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 111 people were killed and hundreds more injured in **Uttar Pradesh** after a powerful storm brought heavy rain, strong winds, and thunderstorms.  The **U.P. Relief Commissioner’s office** reported damage to homes, trees, and electric poles across 26 districts. **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** directed officials to provide aid to victims and release compensation. **Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav** called for comprehensive relief efforts and urged the government to assess losses and ensure insurance payments.

recent_articles.title: BJP, Congress attack SP over party spokesperson’s remark on Brahmins; FIR registered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajkumar Bhati**, a spokesperson for the **Samajwadi Party**, faced backlash after a video surfaced showing him making derogatory remarks against the Brahmin community.  **Pankaj Chaudhary**, the state BJP president and Union Minister, condemned the comments as "indecent" and said they reflected the SP's "divide and rule" mentality. Deputy Chief Minister **Brajesh Pathak** called the remarks "disgusting" and a reflection of the SP's character.  **Ajay Rai**, the state Congress chief, demanded disciplinary action against Bhati and an apology from **Akhilesh Yadavji**, the SP chief. A case was filed against Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: Prateek Yadav, Mulayam Singh Yadav’s younger son, passes away in Lucknow - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prateek Yadav**, the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister **Mulayam Singh Yadav** and husband of BJP leader **Aparna Bisht Yadav**, passed away on Wednesday morning at the age of 38.  He was pronounced dead after being rushed to a hospital in Lucknow where doctors could not determine the cause of death.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, expressed condolences and offered prayers for the departed soul.

recent_articles.title: Modi’s austerity drive is an admission of failure on economic and foreign policy fronts, alleges Akhilesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** appeal for austerity in light of the Iran conflict, accusing the **BJP government** of failing on both economic and foreign policy fronts.  Yadav argued that the appeal was an admission of failure and that the restrictions imposed were disproportionate to the perceived crisis. He also accused the **BJP** of fueling political unrest with electoral fraud and social discord.

recent_articles.title: Suvendu Adhikari to chair first Cabinet meeting on May 11, 2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, the newly elected Chief Minister of **West Bengal**, will hold his first cabinet meeting on Monday, May 11, at Nabanna.  The meeting will see the allocation of portfolios to five ministers who were sworn in with him on Saturday. The cabinet is expected to establish inquiry commissions into atrocities against women during the **Trinamool Congress** regime. Adhikari also plans to meet with top officials from various departments including the police and district magistrates.

recent_articles.title: WB CM Suvendu Adhikari to chair first cabinet meeting today - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, the newly elected Chief Minister of West Bengal, will hold his first cabinet meeting on Monday (May 11, 2026) at Nabanna. The meeting is expected to allocate portfolios to five ministers who were sworn in alongside him on Saturday (May 9). **Adhikari** also plans to establish inquiry commissions into atrocities against women during the previous Trinamool Congress regime and meet with top officials of various departments including police, district magistrates, and the Director General of West Bengal police.

recent_articles.title: Independent media outlets and online critics: Far from a safe harbour - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sanjay Sharma**, editor of an evening newspaper in Lucknow, recounted being summoned by a senior official close to the **Chief Minister’s Office** six months after the 2017 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The official told Sharma that the **Chief Minister** was upset with him and believed he was aligned with **Akhilesh Yadav**, the Samajwadi Party chief who served as Chief Minister from 2012 to 2017.

recent_articles.title: Election Commission, and not the BJP, seems to be fighting Trinamool in West Bengal, says Kapil Sibal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kapil Sibal**, a senior Supreme Court lawyer and Rajya Sabha MP, criticized the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**'s actions in West Bengal ahead of the upcoming elections. He accused the **EC** and the **BJP** of working together to suppress the Trinamool Congress (TMC), alleging an "unconstitutional Emergency" and a disproportionate deployment of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).  Other opposition leaders, including **Arvind Kejriwal**, have also expressed concern over the situation.

recent_articles.title: Yogi leads march against Opposition; Akhilesh predicts U.P. poll defeat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in Uttar Pradesh held a protest march against the **Congress** and **Samajwadi Party** for voting against the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026. The bill aimed to redistribute Lok Sabha seats based on the 2011 Census to expedite the implementation of women's reservation.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister, led the march and criticized the opposition parties for opposing women's rights. **Akhilesh Yadav**, the Samajwadi Party president, called the protest a "practice" before the BJP could become the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: Delimitation and Women’s reservation: Key parties’ stance - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** government is considering an amendment to the Women’s Reservation Act, proposing a 33% reservation for women in parliament.  The plan to link the amendment with delimitation has sparked political debate, with **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and **Indian National Congress (INC)** offering contrasting stances. The BJP advocates increasing Lok Sabha seats to ensure 273 reserved seats without reducing men's representation. The INC opposes the delimitation link, demanding a fresh caste census for reservation calculations and criticizing the move as a political tactic. Other parties like the DMK, CPI(M), BRS, and SP have also voiced their opinions on the proposed amendments.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc opposes Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee (AICC)**, announced that the INDIA bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  **Kharge** stated that opposition parties are not against the Women’s Reservation Bill but are concerned about the bill's linking with delimitation and seat increases in State Assemblies. Several Opposition leaders, including **T.R. Baalu**, **Tejashwi Yadav**, and **Sanjay Raut**, expressed their opposition to the Delimitation Bill.

recent_articles.title: Women’s reservation Bill rushed by govt. to sidestep caste count, says Akhilesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, criticized the **Union government** for rushing the women's reservation bill without adequate consultation, alleging it is intended to prevent the caste count from being factored into the implementation of the 33% reservation ahead of the 2029 Lok Sabha election.  He questioned the government's decision to proceed with delimitation without updated population data and asked why they are not accounting for the caste count while enacting such legislation.

recent_articles.title: Women's reservation in Parliament: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, leader of the **Samajwadi Party**, criticized the proposed women's reservation, arguing that a fresh census is necessary before implementing it. He stated that the basis of the reservation depends on accurate population data derived from a census and that using outdated figures from the 2011 Census would be flawed.  **Yadav** demanded a fresh census before proceeding with the issue of women's reservation, accusing the ruling **BJP** of misleading women.

recent_articles.title: Enemies of the ‘Ambedkar Constitution’ have to be routed in the polls: Akhilesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, launched his campaign for the 2027 Assembly elections in Western Uttar Pradesh, emphasizing the "suffering" experienced by backward classes (PDA) and accusing the BJP of divisive politics.  He criticized the Yogi Adityanath government's development record and alleged that it was hindering job opportunities for youth. **Yadav** also targeted the BJP's handling of airports, claiming they were mismanaged and promised to prioritize farmers' interests in future airport expansion plans.

recent_articles.title: When defeat becomes apparent person loses control over words, says Samajwadi Party on PM Modi’s ‘ATM for loot’ jibe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Samajwadi Party** criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, accusing him of falsely claiming that the party made Noida an "ATM for looting". The SP, however, highlighted the economic growth of Noida during their tenure due to planned industrial clusters, affordable housing, and metro connectivity.  They emphasized that Noida's development was based on infrastructure, employment, and inclusive urban planning.
